notes: No token, database, upload, log, or customer document is included.
Use only from an approved deployment share. Do not copy a freshly compiled EXE directly to a billing PC.

Fix in this build: the P1007 office-copy grant is now re-validated against the live copy count right before printing, instead of trusting the count read only once when the Voucher Print window first opened. A copy count edited after the window qualifies (e.g. down to 1) now safely falls back to P355 instead of incorrectly still using P1007.
